Settings.Name: Preset
Settings.Description: Fast preset for overall tuning. Advanced Mode exposes the full control set, and manual edits to preset-owned advanced settings switch this to CUSTOM.

Settings.Name: Advanced Mode
Settings.Description: Shows the full tuning controls. Presets remain the simple entry point; manual edits to preset-owned advanced settings switch Preset to CUSTOM.

Settings.Name: Combat Extender Compatibility
Settings.Description: Use lighter tier/champion scaling when Combat Extender (or similar scaling mods) is active. Prevents double-stacking difficulty.

Settings.Name: Skip Beach Tutorial Ambush
Settings.Description: Skips the one-time beach wake-up tutorial ambush and marks the tutorial flow completed.

Settings.Name: Ambush Intensity
Settings.Description: Multiplier applied to point budget. Advanced Mode only; when Advanced Mode is OFF, Preset values are authoritative.

Settings.Name: Scale With Party Size
Settings.Description: Scales ambush point budget based on party size (fewer members = lighter ambushes, more = heavier). Always ON unless Advanced Mode is enabled - toggle only takes effect in Advanced Mode.

Settings.Name: Strict Progression Gates
Settings.Description: Enforces min/max party-level gates for ambush templates. Advanced Mode only; this is a global guardrail and is not preset-owned.

Settings.Name: Use Composition Guards
Settings.Description: Applies per-ambush power-class caps to prevent too many heavy units at once. Advanced Mode only; this is a global guardrail and is not preset-owned.

Settings.Name: Scaling Profile
Settings.Description: Choose the progression track used for scaling. Extended 13-20 is for level-cap mods; Vanilla 1-12 is for default BG3 progression.

Settings.Name: Enable Reputation System
Settings.Description: Tracks creature-type reputation and can escalate to champions over time.

Settings.Name: Show Threshold Warnings
Settings.Description: Shows message-box warnings when reputation thresholds are crossed (more intrusive).

Settings.Name: Decay Rate
Settings.Description: How fast negative reputation decays toward 0 on periodic decay ticks while out of combat.

Settings.Name: Allow Ambush Checks In Vulnerable Moments
Settings.Description: Allows hunters to strike during brief and extended respites.

Settings.Name: Enable Time-In-Danger Pressure
Settings.Description: Lets exposure in dangerous areas build extra ambush pressure over time, including passive travel danger checks. Turning this OFF clears stored time-in-danger buildup.

Settings.Name: Respect Safety Checks
Settings.Description: Prevents ambushes in unsafe states (dialog/cinematics/camp restrictions). Recommended ON.

Settings.Name: Allow Camp Ambushes
Settings.Description: If enabled, ambushes may occur in camp/safe zones. Recommended OFF for a vanilla feel.

Settings.Name: Enable Cooldown
Settings.Description: Adds a per-player cooldown between ambushes. Advanced Mode only; Preset controls this when Advanced Mode is OFF.

Settings.Name: Cooldown (Minutes)
Settings.Description: Cooldown duration in minutes. Advanced Mode only; Preset controls this when Advanced Mode is OFF.

Settings.Name: Brief Respite Chance (%)
Settings.Description: Chance for hunters to strike during a brief respite. Advanced Mode only; Preset values are authoritative when Advanced Mode is OFF.

Settings.Name: Extended Respite Chance (%)
Settings.Description: Chance for hunters to strike during an extended respite. Advanced Mode only; Preset values are authoritative when Advanced Mode is OFF.

Settings.Name: Brief Respite Delay Min
Settings.Description: Minimum delay before hunters can strike after a brief respite. Advanced Mode only.

Settings.Name: Brief Respite Delay Max
Settings.Description: Maximum delay before hunters can strike after a brief respite. Advanced Mode only.

Settings.Name: Extended Respite Delay Min
Settings.Description: Minimum delay before hunters can strike after an extended respite. Advanced Mode only.

Settings.Name: Extended Respite Delay Max
Settings.Description: Maximum delay before hunters can strike after an extended respite. Advanced Mode only.

Settings.Name: Quick Test Vulnerability Flow
Settings.Description: Tester helper (runtime override): forces 100% ambush chance, immediate vulnerability checks (0 minute delay), and disables cooldown without rewriting saved sliders.

Settings.Name: Enable Ambush System
Settings.Description: Master toggle for the ambush and retaliation system.

Settings.Name: Use Vanilla Enemy Pool
Settings.Description: Use the built-in vanilla enemy list. Turn OFF only if an external provider or compatibility patch is installed; otherwise ambushes may have no valid enemy pool.

Settings.Name: Apply Surprise on Ambush
Settings.Description: Runs the ambush surprise check for eligible party members when combat starts. Party members that pass the Perception check or have immunity effects are not surprised.

Settings.Name: Enable Alert Popups
Settings.Description: Master toggle for ambush, reputation, and champion popup notifications. Immersion cues still play when OFF.

Settings.Name: Show Pre-Ambush Warnings
Settings.Description: Shows warning text popups before ambushes. Requires ambush UI notifications master toggle.

Settings.Name: Show Champion Arrival Alerts
Settings.Description: Shows a popup when a champion spawns. Requires ambush UI notifications master toggle.

Settings.Name: Arrival Cue Policy
Settings.Description: Controls ambient arrival cues for spawned ambushers. Balanced uses the tier chance table and the scale slider. Always On forces cue attempts for visibility. Off disables extra arrival cues and keeps only the baseline spawn VFX fallback.

Settings.Name: Arrival Cue Chance Scale (%)
Settings.Description: Scales Balanced arrival-cue chance from 0% to 200%. Ignored when Arrival Cue Policy is Always On or Off.

Settings.Name: Spawn Placement Mode
Settings.Description: Controls how ambushers pick spawn locations. Auto keeps the current hybrid behavior. Find Valid Only skips CreateOutOfSight. Create OOS Only skips normal FindValid loops and only uses the hard fallback if the API itself fails.

Settings.Name: Enable Escapes
Settings.Description: Allows non-champion ambushers to attempt fleeing after prolonged combat. Advanced Mode only; Preset controls this when Advanced Mode is OFF.

Settings.Name: Escape Start Turn
Settings.Description: Turn number at which escape checks begin. Advanced Mode only.

Settings.Name: Escape DC
Settings.Description: Escape check target: d20 + bonuses vs this DC. Advanced Mode only.

Settings.Name: Escape HP Threshold (%)
Settings.Description: Ambushers only attempt escape at or below this HP percentage. Advanced Mode only.

Settings.Name: Max Escapes Per Combat
Settings.Description: Maximum successful ambusher escapes allowed per combat. Advanced Mode only.

Settings.Name: Ambush XP (%)
Settings.Description: Ambush XP as a percent of normal enemy XP. Advanced Mode only; when Advanced Mode is OFF, Preset values are authoritative.

Settings.Name: Disable Generated Ambush Loot
Settings.Description: If enabled, ambush corpses stay interactable but generated ambush loot is cleared while normal corpse interaction and equipped gear remain (prevents economy inflation). Preset baseline: Wayfarer OFF, Marked/Relentless/Hunted ON.

Settings.Name: Allow Champion Loot
Settings.Description: If enabled, champions can keep loot even when ambush loot is disabled (advanced). Preset baseline: Wayfarer ON, Marked/Relentless/Hunted OFF.

Settings.Name: Verbose Debug Mode
Settings.Description: Enables verbose debug prints.

Settings.Name: Robust Safety Mode
Settings.Description: Adds extra safety guards/logging to reduce edge-case errors (recommended OFF unless troubleshooting).

Settings.Name: Point Budget Override (Debug)
Settings.Description: Expert/debug override. 0 = Auto scaling. >0 forces a fixed encounter budget and can easily unbalance progression.
